reason: A DeepSeek Harness queue-consumption plugin that lets users merge multiple queued follow-up text messages into one model-synthesized prompt before execution, with safeguards for failures, attachments, and concurrent queue changes.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 中多个排队的文本追问合并为一个正式提示后再执行，并提供合并或逐条处理的队列策略选择。
summaries.en: Merges multiple queued text follow-ups into one synthesized prompt for the next DeepSeek Harness turn, with a choice between merged and individual queue processing.

capabilities: Consolidates multiple queued text messages into one prompt using a model
Changes the queue consumption policy and replaces queued text messages with the consolidated prompt
Provides UI controls for choosing merged or individual queue processing
Skips consolidation for attachments and non-human messages
Preserves queued messages when synthesis fails or the queue changes during synthesis
